purpose: Extend the 80 registered TWELL dynamic concepts into executable retarded, exponential, two-timescale, resonant, hysteretic, and stochastic source-history laws; identify exact equivalences and real dynamic discriminators before opening observational response data.

normalization.source_perturbation: u=(S-S_ref)/S_star is dimensionless and may be signed; no formula may use a response value to define S_ref or S_star.
normalization.memory_response: q is dimensionless and enters a receiver only through a_eff=a_instantaneous+epsilon*a_star*q; epsilon and a_star are not fitted in this response-blind packet.
normalization.time: s=t/T_star is dimensionless. T_star must ultimately be derived from the registered physical driver (density, curvature, crossing time, or source dynamics), never chosen per observed response.
normalization.receiver_power: Delta P_receiver=m*v dot (epsilon*a_star*q). A fundamental completion must balance this with source plus mediator stress energy; a kernel fingerprint alone does not establish conservation.

kernels.energy_accounting: receiver work is supplied directly by the instantaneous source/field sector
a lossless delay requires a propagating mediator or delay line; its stress energy is not derived here

kernels.causal_support: K(s)=exp(-s/tau)/tau for s>=0 and zero otherwise
kernels.energy_accounting: tau*d(q^2/2)/ds+q^2=u*q; q^2 is positive dissipation that requires a receiver/mediator bath

kernels.zero_memory_limit: tau1,tau2->0 gives K00; tau1=tau2 collapses exactly to K02
kernels.causal_support: positive weighted sum of two one-sided exponential kernels
kernels.energy_accounting: the weighted sum of the two one-pole storage-dissipation identities closes the normalized state ledger

kernels.zero_memory_limit: omega0->infinity at fixed finite frequency gives K00
kernels.causal_support: retarded Green function of the stable second-order state equation

kernels.equation: b switches to +1 at u>=h and -1 at u<=-h; tau_h*q'+q=u+kappa*b
kernels.causal_support: branch state uses only past threshold crossings
kernels.energy_accounting: the quasistatic loop dissipates 4*kappa*h per normalized cycle; branch switching requires a declared reservoir

kernels.static_limit: E[q]=u and Var(q)=sigma^2*tau/2 for a constant source
kernels.zero_memory_limit: sigma->0 gives K02 in mean; tau->0 and sigma->0 gives K00
kernels.causal_support: adapted to the past source and Wiener filtration; no future increment enters
kernels.energy_accounting: the Ito bath injects tau*sigma^2/2, exactly balancing stationary fluctuation dissipation when u=0

frozen_predictions: K01 is exactly absorbed by an unconstrained common emission/coalescence-time shift and cannot be discovered from one event

K06 has the K02 conditional mean plus a common astrophysical excess-variance component; uncorrelated detector noise is a negative control

HDF5 strain channel, GPS start, duration, sample rate, and data-quality masks
independent H1/L1 calibration and noise metadata
prediction receipt hash predating every response read

strongest_counterexample.interpretation: A large static fossil-history search produced a tempting nuisance-relative gain but no selection-aware or instantaneous-baseline evidence. Static fossil histories do not measure phase, rate-persistent hysteresis, resonance, or stochastic coherence.

decision_rules.static: Unit DC gain is an equivalence, not evidence for or against any linear memory architecture.
decision_rules.delay: A pure common delay is not identifiable when emission/coalescence time is free.
decision_rules.one_frequency: One complex frequency response is absorbable into one amplitude and phase; at least two frequencies or a resolved transition are required.
decision_rules.stochastic: K06 and K02 are exactly equal in conditional mean; variance/coherence is mandatory.
decision_rules.hysteresis: A nonzero loop-area intercept as drive rate approaches zero distinguishes rate-persistent hysteresis from stable finite-memory LTI lag.
decision_rules.resonance: A magnitude peak above unity distinguishes underdamped K04 from K01/K02/K03, but source ringdown is the mandatory countermodel.
decision_rules.conservation: A dissipative or stochastic kernel remains a phenomenological open-system law until its bath/source stress energy is explicit; it is retained, not silently rejected.
decision_rules.publication: A methods/theory note may report the exact equivalence classes and discriminator basis. An empirical gravity claim requires unchanged cross-event transfer and a derived T_star/S_star, not per-event retuning.
